netsuite.title: Custom applications.
paragraphs: We build custom applications that simplify daily work through clearer screens, automated tasks and connected tools. Employees spend less time switching between pages, repeating manual steps and entering the same information in different systems.

replacements.title: Choose the right tool.
paragraphs: We compare configuration, existing products and custom development around the features your team actually needs. Licensing, implementation and ongoing support all belong in that decision. Sometimes the right answer is to improve what you already use.

ai.title: AI agents and assistants.
paragraphs: We connect AI agents to NetSuite, business documents and your other tools. Employees can ask questions, analyse information and get help with tasks, spending less time searching across systems.
We embed assistants in custom applications to guide users through their work and help them take action directly in the application, with fewer manual steps.

stock.title: Stock questions, with context.
stock.body: Bring stock, incoming supply and forecasts together to investigate an exception. The source data, its freshness and the next person to act matter as much as the view.

quick-so.title: Sales orders in one clear screen.
quick-so.summary: A simpler way for sales teams to choose products and create an order directly in NetSuite.
quick-so.problem: Sales teams had to use NetSuite’s standard sales-order form. The process felt slow and hard to follow, making a routine part of their job frustrating.
quick-so.solution: We built a dedicated order-entry screen with the customer, products, quantities and order details together. Employees prepare and review the order in one clear interface. Once submitted, the sales order is created automatically in NetSuite.
quick-so.forYou: What would make work easier for your team? We build custom applications to simplify everyday tasks, automate repetitive work and connect your tools.

prp-v2.title: A simpler alternative to a costly sales tool.
prp-v2.summary: We built sales features directly in NetSuite to replace a separate sales application.
prp-v2.problem: The team was paying for a sales application that employees found difficult to use. The team needed the core sales features without the complexity and cost of that separate tool.
prp-v2.solution: We built the required sales features directly in NetSuite, bringing customers, products, prices, stock and orders together. Saved carts and order templates let employees resume work and prepare repeat orders without starting again.
prp-v2.forYou: Which tool is expensive but still frustrates your team? We can build a simpler replacement around the features you use, comparing its development and support costs with the licences you could remove.

supply-chain-workbench.title: Stock and forecasts in the same view.
supply-chain-workbench.summary: A planning table to spot potential shortages and check incoming supply.
supply-chain-workbench.problem: The team needed to compare stock, forecasts and incoming deliveries to spot shortages and plan purchases. A stock figure on its own did not give enough context.
supply-chain-workbench.solution: We built a planning table that brings this information together by product, location and period. Employees can see where stock may run short and open the related purchase orders to investigate, without losing the overall view.
supply-chain-workbench.forYou: Which figures does your team need to compare before making a decision? We can bring them into one working view, highlight what needs attention and make the supporting details easy to reach.

quoting-assistants.title: AI across your tools and applications.
quoting-assistants.summary: Agents that answer questions and help with tasks across NetSuite, documents and other tools. Assistants embedded in custom applications to guide users as they work.
quoting-assistants.problem: Finding information in NetSuite can be slow. Analysing information spread across documents and tools quickly takes up time that employees could spend on their work.
quoting-assistants.solution:
Across your tools, we implement agents connected to NetSuite, documents and other business systems. They help employees find answers, analyse information and carry out everyday tasks.

Inside your custom applications, we embed assistants that guide users, explain what to do and help them complete actions more easily and quickly.
quoting-assistants.forYou: What would you like an agent to help your team with? We can connect it to your tools and documents, or integrate an assistant into a custom application to guide the people using it.

page.title: Simplify NetSuite order preparation
page.description: Too many steps to prepare a NetSuite order? TG Tech helps scope one workflow, compare existing tools and define a practical improvement with clear acceptance checks.

hero.title: Preparing an order.
hero.body: Customer details in one place, products in another, a draft to rebuild. TG Tech helps simplify a specific order workflow in NetSuite, starting with what your existing tools can already do.

example.label: A concrete starting point
example.title: From a customer request to a reviewed order.
example.disclosure: Synthetic demonstration: no connected NetSuite system and no order created.

steps.title: Find the customer context
steps.body: Identify the customer, the person preparing the order and the information they need.

steps.title: Prepare and resume the draft
steps.body: Bring the lines together and define what must be kept when work is interrupted.

steps.title: Make an exception visible
steps.body: An unconfirmed price needs a named reviewer. Keep it visible before the order moves on.

steps.title: Check the handoff
steps.body: Agree which checks allow submission, who can submit and how to confirm the resulting order.

options.title: Start with what you already have.
options.body: A new interface is one possible answer. We compare three routes against the same task.

items.title: Adjust the existing setup
items.body: Check whether your current forms, settings and working practices can remove the difficult step.

items.title: Use an existing product
items.body: Assess the workflow fit, access needs, licences and support before adding another tool.

items.title: Build a focused extension
items.body: When a gap remains, define the smallest useful screen or connection and how it will be maintained.

scope.title: A first piece of work you can accept.
scope.body: One workflow, agreed users and clear boundaries. The proposal defines the change, required data and access, acceptance checks, handover and support.
scope.diagnostic: If the correction is already clear, scope it directly. A paid diagnostic only makes sense when its findings are useful in their own right.
acceptance: A draft can be resumed without re-entering its lines.
An unresolved price is visible and has an owner.
An authorised user can complete the agreed handoff and verify its result.
scope.boundary: These criteria must be agreed and tested in your environment, with your configuration, access rights and business rules.

evidence.label: Related work
evidence.title: Order screens and reusable drafts.
evidence.body: Our documented sales application work brings customer, product and order information together, with saved carts and repeat-order templates.
evidence.limit: The example describes capabilities. It does not establish current production adoption, measured savings or a product that can be installed unchanged.
evidence.stock: Is the difficult step a stock question? See the workbench.
